//: Architecture responses to properties no passive evidence can establish, read by scripts/matcher-evidence/gate.ts. An entry counts only when its evidence checks out by machine: `tests` must name tests that passed in the same suite run (VERIFIED_BY_TEST), and `record` must be a committed human-evidence file whose evidenceClass is VERIFIED_LIVE_HUMAN for this property. Setting `met` without such evidence changes nothing.

riderSeesAndCanUndoAutomaticPick.source: No rider client drives a real journey session yet: the iOS app runs the deterministic demo only (apps/ios/TapsoApp/TapsoAppModel.swift startDemo; test/crossLanguageAuthority.test.ts proves it makes no network request). There is therefore no rider-visible undo for an automatic pick.

destinationAlertIndependentOfProviderLag.source: Destination progress is derived from the provider stop sequence (services/api/src/journeySession.ts evaluateSelectedObservation). TAGO publishes no observation time, so the lag between a physical stop and the provider's report is unmeasured and the alert timing depends on it.

physicalDeviceLiveActivityVerified.source: docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md: physical-device Lock Screen and Dynamic Island behaviour is UNVERIFIED; no device is registered to an available Apple team (paid membership missing). This is a device check, not a bus ride.

riderBoardsFirstArrivingBusMeasured.source: The passive ground truth is the first-arrival rider model (services/api/src/passiveShadow.ts). Whether real riders board the first bus cannot be observed without riders; the product contract does not depend on it below READY_FOR_AUTOMATIC_MATCHING.
